clue.text: Very good beans meal explosive for mariner

parts.note: something first-rate is graded A, as in A1

indicators.note: an explosive mix flies apart, so these letters are blown into a new order

explanation.surface: A sailor's verdict on a bean dinner with violent after-effects.
explanation.walkthrough: 'explosive' rearranges BEANSMEAL into BLESEAMAN, after A for 'Very good'.
explanation.definitionFit: An able seaman is a rank of ordinary sailor in the Royal Navy, so a mariner.

clue.text: Bless and make lovely when non-U

indicators.note: non- denies what follows, so the letter U named after it is dropped

parts.note: to make lovely is to beautify

explanation.surface: A posh joke: what counts as blessing when you are not upper-class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'non-U' is British slang for not upper-class; here it says remove U.
explanation.definitionFit: To beatify is for the Church to declare someone blessed, a step towards sainthood.

clue.text: Maybe Terry feels lie-in regularly needed

indicators.note: taking letters at regular intervals, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: Someone called Terry fancies a lazy morning in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: Ellen Terry was a celebrated Victorian actress; 'Maybe' marks her as one example of an Ellen.
explanation.definitionFit: Terry is a surname borne by the actress Ellen Terry, so the first name is an example.

clue.text: So black tie worn, being upwardly mobile to the same degree

indicators.note: the turned tie is worn around the other pieces, enclosing them
in a down clue the word tie is read from the bottom up

parts.note: so, as in 'so good', means very
B is the abbreviation for black on pencils

explanation.surface: Social climbers dress in black tie to fit in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upwardly mobile' is a social-climbing image, but in a down entry it means read upwards; 'worn' has the tie wrapped round the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'every bit as good' means equally good, so the phrase expresses equal extent.

clue.text: Devilish Farage? His best man has to catch up

parts.note: Nigel Farage, British politician, was a Member of the European Parliament
taken as written
top means best
a man is he

indicators.note: in a down clue, up reads the word backwards from the bottom

parts.note: to nail a criminal is to catch them

explanation.surface: A dig at British politician Nigel Farage and his wedding companion's attempt to keep pace.
explanation.definitionFit: Mephistopheles is the demon of the Faust legend, so the adjective means fiendish.

clue.text: Small number remove clothing and fall asleep

parts.note: No. is the short form of number
to doff is to take off a hat or garment

explanation.surface: A few people undress and drift off to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: To nod off is the idiom for dozing, drifting into sleep.

clue.text: Feeling anger shown by female

parts.note: ire is anger

explanation.surface: A woman shows her fury.
explanation.definitionFit: Fire can mean passion or ardour, a strong emotion.

clue.text: Surveyor reserving a seat for the bishop to eat this?

indicators.note: reserving holds something back within, so the letters of Surveyor enclose a

parts.note: FRICS: Fellow of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors
a see is a bishop's seat or diocese

explanation.surface: A surveyor keeps a place at the table for the bishop's dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A fricassee is a stew of meat in a white sauce, a dish to be eaten.

clue.text: Old student pair visits circus in motion

indicators.note: a visitor goes inside, so these pieces enter the circus word

parts.note: a circus performs in a ring

indicators.note: a pair means two copies of the student letter

parts.note: L is the learner sign, a student driver

explanation.surface: An elderly pair of students go to the circus.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rolling is moving along, turning as it goes.

clue.text: Signal to stop bombardment

definitions.meaning: you wave to halt a taxi or call to a ship
a barrage, as a shower of bullets or blows

explanation.definitionFit: To hail a cab is to flag it down; a hail of stones is a heavy volley.

clue.text: Footwear imparts energy to digger crossing stream

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy

indicators.note: the spade lies across the stream, so its letters straddle the other word

parts.note: a spade is a digging tool
a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: A gardener's spade gets a burst of vigour as it cuts through a brook.
explanation.definitionFit: An espadrille is a rope-soled canvas shoe, a kind of shoe.

clue.text: Name on papers in important organ

indicators.note: the identity letters sit inside the important word

parts.note: key means crucial

indicators.note: name goes on after papers, following it

parts.note: ID, identity papers

explanation.surface: A form of identity is recorded for an essential bodily organ, as on a donor card.
explanation.definitionFit: The kidney is one of the body's vital organs, filtering blood.

clue.text: In French one barbed comment is demeaning

parts.note: a is one
a dig is a snide remark

explanation.surface: A cutting remark in French is considered beneath one.
explanation.definitionFit: Infra dig, from Latin, means beneath one's dignity, so degrading.

clue.text: Wordsmith Cyril, demented, is given time

indicators.note: demented means deranged, so these letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A deranged writer called Cyril is handed a prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A lyricist writes song words, so is a crafter of words.

clue.text: Bemused if no males found here?

definitions.text: Bemused if no males found here?

indicators.note: bemused means confused, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: Puzzlement at a place where no men can be found.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke: the island is named for Man, yet the clue imagines it without any. It lies in the Irish Sea.
explanation.definitionFit: This Irish Sea island, a Crown dependency, is the place the whole clue points to with irony.

clue.text: Long story? It's about Silver

parts.note: 'it' is old slang for sex appeal, SA

indicators.note: about means turned around, so the symbol is read backwards

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A long tale concerning a character named Silver, perhaps Long John.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is a lengthy narrative, originally a Norse heroic tale.

clue.text: One biased to find cosy place to keep first pension amount?

indicators.note: keeping something holds it within, so the cosy word encloses the rest

parts.note: a nest is a snug home
a pension pot is the saved sum
I, the Roman numeral one, comes first

explanation.surface: Someone seeks a safe home for their pension savings.
explanation.definitionFit: A nepotist favours relatives when handing out jobs, showing partiality.

clue.text: Lehman went to this rich Manhattan street

definitions.meaning: Lehman Brothers, the bank, collapsed in 2008; going 'to the ___' means failing
New York's famous finance street, short for its full name

explanation.definitionFit: Firms that fail are said to go to the wall, and the New York finance district is named after a street there.

clue.text: Lover requires a physician to bandage something unpleasant

indicators.note: a bandage wraps around, so the doctor's letters enclose the other piece

parts.note: Dr is the abbreviation for doctor
mire is mud or a nasty mess

explanation.surface: A sweetheart needs a doctor to dress a nasty wound.
explanation.definitionFit: An admirer is a suitor, someone romantically attracted.

clue.text: Lowborn student in training to live with Scotsman

indicators.note: the student letter goes inside the training letters

parts.note: PE, physical education
L is the learner sign
to be is to exist
Ian is a typical Scottish name

explanation.surface: A humble trainee moves in with a Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: Plebeian means of the common people, of humble birth.

clue.text: Aloe vera not very active in sunken spots

indicators.note: active means busy and lively, so the letters are set moving into a new order

explanation.surface: Aloe vera, the plant gel, lacking strength, is used on hollow patches of skin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not very' removes V from ALOEVERA, and 'active' rearranges the remaining ALOEERA.
explanation.definitionFit: Areolae are small pits or spaces in tissue or surfaces, hollows.

clue.text: Former Israeli leader has broken right leg

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so these letters are reassembled

parts.note: in cricket the leg side is also called the on side

explanation.surface: An ex-premier of Israel suffers a broken right leg.
explanation.definitionFit: Ariel Sharon served as Prime Minister of Israel from 2001 to 2006.

clue.text: She and I crazily entertain dubious charmer

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to take them in, so the jumbled letters hold the rest
crazily means wildly, so these letters scatter

parts.note: a moot point is debatable, open to doubt

explanation.surface: Two people foolishly host a slippery smooth-talker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crazily' rearranges SHEI into SHIE, which then holds MOOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoothie is a suave, ingratiating person, a smooth operator.

clue.text: Celebrity chef's duck pâté ingredient?

parts.note: in cricket a duck is a score of zero, O
liver is the base of many pâtés

explanation.surface: A famous cook's duck liver pâté.
explanation.definitionFit: Jamie Oliver is a well-known British television cook.

clue.text: Experience hot dog

parts.note: in means fashionable, the hot thing
a cur is a mongrel

explanation.surface: Undergo a hot dog, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: To incur a cost or penalty is to suffer or undergo it.

clue.text: Thirsty bird one to get drink

parts.note: dry means thirsty
a martin is a swallow-like bird
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A parched bird wants a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry martini is a cocktail of gin with a little vermouth.

clue.text: Heartless Conservative veteran

parts.note: a veteran is old

explanation.surface: An elderly Tory is unfeeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone cold lacks warmth or compassion, being unfeeling.

clue.text: Irish working in club

parts.note: on means operating, switched on

explanation.surface: An Irishman employed at a club or society.
explanation.definitionFit: An iron is a type of golf club with a metal head.

clue.text: He flees north-eastern ground in Turkey

indicators.note: ground means milled to bits, so the remaining letters are reshaped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A man escapes north-eastern territory in the country of Turkey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He flees' removes H and E from NORTHEASTERN; 'ground' rearranges the rest. 'Turkey' is not the country but a flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A turkey is slang for a failure or flop, something that never gets going.
